product.summary: Standalone Sequence smart wallet for managing assets and connecting to external Web3 applications.
product.notes: Selected Universal Wallet boundary only. Sequence Embedded Wallet remains a separate product architecture and is deferred.

events.title: Sequence Wallet infrastructure update released
events.description: Sequence announced and deployed a major wallet infrastructure update with faster login, cross-network session improvements, recovery improvements, and EIP-1271 integration changes.

evidence.title: Sequence Wallet security
evidence.notes: First-party security article states Sequence is non-custodial and cannot access wallet contents. The selected product is the standalone Universal Wallet rather than Embedded Wallet.

evidence.title: Sequence Wallet update - A better, faster, and smoother experience for builders and users
evidence.notes: First-party Sequence post announcing that a major wallet infrastructure update was pushed on 2023-06-21.
